name: Greek Dinner
description: Falafel with lemon potatoes, horiatiki and tzatziki. Everything lands on the table at once if you follow the timeline.

timeline.heading: Prep & roast the potatoes
timeline.text: They take the longest to cook, about an hour. Get them in the oven first.

timeline.heading: Flash-dry the chickpeas
timeline.text: Pop them into the oven right alongside the potatoes for 10 minutes.

timeline.heading: Make the tzatziki
timeline.text: Mix it up and let it chill in the fridge so the flavours marry.

timeline.heading: Make the falafel mix
timeline.text: Blend the ingredients, then stir in the chickpea flour and egg and chill for 30 minutes so it binds.

timeline.heading: Chop the Greek salad
timeline.text: Chop your fresh vegetables while the falafel mixture chills.

timeline.heading: Shape and fry the falafel
timeline.text: Fry the patties right before serving so they are hot and crispy.
